cross_references.relationship: §1826(a)(4)(B) cross-references §811 directly — investigator must assess §811 mental function deficits; §811 is the clinical framework the §1826 investigation must apply

§811 deficits must meet the §1801 threshold — the functional impairment identified under §811 must rise to 'unable to provide for personal needs' (§1801(a)) or 'substantially unable to manage finances or resist fraud' (§1801(b)). §811 identifies the functional deficit; §1801 sets the threshold that deficit must meet.
